
A <span class="text-red">red word</span>, a <span class="text-green">green one</span>, <span class="text-blue">blue</span> and <span class="text-purple">purple</span>.

<span class="text-highlight">Gold</span>, <span class="text-highlight">yellow</span>, <span class="text-highlight">orange</span> and <span class="text-highlight">highlight</span> share a style.

<span class="text-muted">Grey</span>, <span class="text-muted">gray</span>, <span class="text-muted">silver</span> and <span class="text-muted">muted</span> share another.

Nested: <span class="text-red">**bold red**</span> and <u><span class="text-blue">underlined blue</span></u>.

Unknown stays literal: [text]{.chartreuse}

Inline code is untouched: `[text]{.red}`

A [link](https://example.com){.red} is not a span.

```
[in a fence]{.red}
```
